levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة
عمر بن عبد الله بن الأرقم

notes: the father «أباه» (Ubayd Allah's father, who wrote to Umar) is a relation link; Umar b. Abdullah heard Subayʿa, and his letter is the report of her words
«تابعه أصبغ عن ابن وهب عن يونس» names other transmitters for the same report: a variant group
the Prophet's answer inside Subayʿa's account is in the saying, not a link
